subject: math
question: 计算 $\lim_{x\to 1}\frac{(1 - x^{\frac{1}{2}})(1 - x^{\frac{1}{3}})\cdots(1 - x^{\frac{1}{n}})}{(1 - x)^{n - 1}}.$
answer: \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {\left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{2}}\right)\left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{3}}\right) \cdots \left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{n}}\right)}{(1 - x) ^ {n - 1}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \left(\frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{2}}}{1 - x} \cdot \frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{3}}}{1 - x} \cdot \dots \cdot \

steps.text: 分析 极限式变形为 $\lim_{x\to1}\left(\frac{1-x^{\frac{1}{2}}}{1-x}\cdot\frac{1-x^{\frac{1}{3}}}{1-x}\cdots\frac{1-x^{\frac{1}{n}}}{1-x}\right)$ ，只需算出各因子 $\frac{1-x^{i}}{1-x}(i=2,3,\cdots,n)$ 的极限.
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{i}}}{1 - x} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 1} \frac {1 - t}{1 - t ^ {i}} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 1} \frac {1}{1 + t + \cdots + t ^ {i - 1}} = \frac {1}{i}.

\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {\left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{2}}\right)\left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{3}}\right) \cdots \left(1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{n}}\right)}{(1 - x) ^ {n - 1}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \left(\frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{2}}}{1 - x} \cdot \frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{3}}}{1 - x} \cdot \dots \cdot \frac {1 - x ^ {\frac {1}{n}}}{1 - x}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{3} \cdot \dots \cdot \frac {1}{n} = \frac {1}{n !}.
